author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에는 겨울철에 미조로 찾아오는 새이다. 산지의 자갈밭이나 바닷가 바위 지대, 용암 지대 등에 살며, 번식기가 아닐 때는 흔히 작은 무리를 지어 지낸다. 여름에는 곤충을 많이 먹고 씨앗과 열매도 즐겨 먹는다. 북극 시베리아, 아나디르 연안, 캄차카 동부 등지에서 번식하며 한배에 알 4~7개, 드물게 8개를 낳고, 시베리아 초원, 몽골, 만주, 사할린, 쿠릴 열도, 중국 허베이성, 일본 북부, 한국 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

sexes.female: 겨울깃은 겉보기에 수컷과 아주 비슷하지만 머리꼭대기 깃털의 기부가 어두운 갈색이다.

art.subject: Snow Bunting (Plectrophenax nivalis), adult male in winter plumage, as seen in Korea from December to February: crown and hindneck buff (white feathers broadly tipped buff); lores and supercilium buff; ear-coverts tawny-brown; mantle and scapulars blackish with broad buff fringes; a tawny-buff patch on the breast sides and tawny tips on the upper breast, rest of the underparts white; wing largely white on the coverts and secondaries, with black primaries forming black wingtips; central tail feathers dark, outer feathers largely white. Bill small but deep, yellow-orange with a dark tip in winter; brown iris; short dull black legs.
art.pose: walking over gravel in a small flock, picking at seeds
art.scene: Korean winter: rocky seashore with dark lava rocks and gravel; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view on the ground: buff crown and hindneck, buff lores and supercilium, tawny-brown ear-coverts, tawny-tipped upper breast and white underparts, small deep yellow-orange bill, short dull black legs, white wing panel
adult female winter, head detail: like the male but the crown feathers have dark brown bases showing through the buff, giving a darker, more mottled crown
art.build: Chunky, short-legged bunting, about 16 cm, a little larger than a sparrow, long-winged and low-slung when walking. Bill small, conical, deep and laterally compressed. Legs short, black, with a long hind claw. At rest the long wings reach well down the short, slightly forked tail; in flight the wings flash large white panels with black tips. Shuffles and runs over gravel and shingle in small flocks.
avoid: Do not paint the black-and-white breeding plumage (white head, black back, black bill) on a winter bird.
Do not paint a black bill in winter; it is yellow-orange with a dark tip.
Do not paint a long thin bill or long legs; the bill is stubby and the legs short.
Do not streak the white belly.
